dct_description_sm: We measured leaf and stem methane fluxes of five tree species in the floodplain of Lake St-Pierre using the Licor Li-7810. Measurements were made in 6 blocks each divided in a 'high flood frequency' and a 'low flood frequency' plot in July 2023, October 2023 and July 2024.  We also measured different environmental parameters (Soil humidity, temperature and conductivity; irradiance) and tree traits (tree diameter, wood and bark density, humidity and pH, leaf humidity, pH and stomatal conductance).
dct_title_s: Methane fluxes from leaves and stems of five tree species (Acer saccharinum, Fraxinus nigra, Populus spp., Salix nigra and Ulmus americana) in the floodplain of Lake St-Pierre (Qc) and their functionnal traits
